What should I do if the tracking never updates?

Tracking can sometimes lag behind the actual package, so a stalled number doesn't always mean a stalled delivery. Carriers also occasionally skip scans, and the record catches up when it's delivered or hits the next hub.

The best move is to have me pull up your order and check the real shipment status, rather than relying on the carrier page alone. Got your order number and ZIP code handy?

Can I reroute the package to a different address?

It depends on whether the order has been processed yet. If it hasn't, you can update the delivery address yourself through the amendment page in your account.

Standard orders can be amended within a short window after ordering, while express orders have an even shorter one since they move into production quickly. How many days ago did you place this order? That'll tell us if you're still within the window.
